title: Orsen and the Ledger
author: Edmund Coldharbour
blurb: Freya Dunmore, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
